timing_honesty.honest_statement: At 64x64 resolution, the classical sparse direct solver is vastly faster than FNO on CPU: 0.501 ms vs 20.477 ms single-query (40.9x faster), and 0.255 ms vs 5.590 ms batched (21.9x faster). Even rebuilding and re-factorizing the sparse matrix from scratch on every query (10.925 ms) is ~1.9x faster than FNO (20.477 ms) on CPU, 64x64. The classical solver is faster, exact, and zero-parameter at this scale.

mode3_coverage_caveat.statement: Mode 3 FNO surrogate achieves sub-millisecond evaluation (0.68 ms) but drops mean 95% Wald coverage to 88.2% across benchmark cells (falling to 61.8% in Extended High-alpha OOD). Mode 3+ hybrid polish routes borderline estimates through localized live Crank-Nicolson solves, recovering 94.0% coverage at the expense of higher fit latency (138.8 ms).

fno_speed_honesty.statement: At 64x64 resolution on CPU, the classical sparse direct solver is vastly faster than FNO: 0.501 ms vs 20.477 ms single-query (40.9x faster) and 0.255 ms vs 5.590 ms batched (21.9x faster). The classical solver is exact, zero-parameter, and pre-factorized.

missed_v2_targets.statement: Final empirical followup evaluation (data/results/task_e_v2_followups.json) established the final state of V2 targets D2, D3, and D5. D2 (Goodness-of-Fit Gate): chi2/dof thresholding exhibits a final false-alarm rate of 4.2% [3.12, 5.63] for N=10 (before: 7.0% in preliminary 100-run sample), 5.4% for N=5, and 5.9% for N=20. The chi2 gate fails to detect AR(1) noise (flag rates 1.0%-2.0%), but the Durbin-Watson diagnostic detects AR(1) noise at 23.9% (rho=0.5), 60.4% (rho=0.8), and 80.5% (rho=0.95). D3 (Range Guard): for alpha=0.0005, the old 1% rule achieved 65.0% (before: 72.0% preliminary), whereas the new multi-criteria rule achieved 90.0% [82.56, 94.48], missing the 95.0% target at 90.0% (100% routed to Mode 3+). D5 (Diagnostic Warnings): the drift warning has no power (3.3/4.2/5.6% detection vs 3.8% false warnings); the kurtosis warning achieves 10-34% (9.8% to 33.6% detection vs 4.5% false warnings).

missed_items.target_spec: Meaningful statistical power over false alarm

poisson_high_mode_breakdown.statement: On high-frequency / out-of-distribution Poisson source terms (wavenumbers m,n > 4), FNO error spikes to 80.4% median relative L2 (max 229.4%), whereas the linear ridge baseline maintains 1.5% median error and the exact sparse direct solver achieves exact numerical precision.
